ask: I'd like to build a new package in packages. It's a sync utility that is similar to ov-sync, but that uses the same logic as the github CI action: https://github.com/JasperHG90/localstack/tree/main/.github/actions/openviking-sync. Namely: it should sync to a P/S queue, not directly to OV so we can better manage the documents being synced in the pipeline. We should still keep state on what is being synced (like ov-sync does) and we should have a config so we can decide where synced docs lands, what is synced and so on. Use go for this, not python.
